notes: All 26 source and 32 target IDs partitioned exactly once.
The supplied *how* is placed on the infinitival complement it introduces under rule 85; the competing fold onto οἴδατε is named in that unit's note as rule 16 requires.
πόσῳ is a degree correlative completed by a dimension word, so the head is *much* and not *how* (rule 104), and μᾶλλον keeps its own *more*.
The postnominal ὁ before the prepositional phrase keeps only the relativizer, the copula going to ἐν (rules 31, 53); ἀγαθά is anarthrous and substantival, so *good things* heads on *good* (rule 17).
